items.title: Tesla to sell Cybercabs to 'select' customers: What to know
items.summary:
Tesla (TSLA) is set to start selling Cybercabs to invited, private customers.

Barron's associate editor Al Root joins "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian to discuss the details.

items.title: Tesla Sells Cybercabs To The Public. It Might Be Because Of A Bet With A YouTuber.
items.summary: YouTuber Marques Brownlee bet he would shave his head if Tesla sold a Cybercab to the general public for under $30,000 by 2026. Cybercab deliveries are scheduled for December.

items.title: Tesla Targets 2029 Cybercab Production Start In Giga Berlin With $3.3B Investment: Report
items.summary: Tesla plans to construct an additional production facility at its German gigafactory with the aim of producing a million units of its Cybercab robotaxis there, Reuters reported.

items.title: Tesla to invest 3 bn euros to expand German factory
items.summary:
US electric carmaker Tesla said Monday it will invest three billion euros ($3.4 billion) to expand its German factory, which will in future have capacity to produce one million driverless Cybercabs annually. 
- 'Enormous significance' -
 
Under the investment plans announced Monday, a new facility will be constructed where up to one million Cybercabs a year will eventually be produced, according to Tesla.

items.title: Musk Says Cybercab’s $300 Monthly Fee Is “Too High.” He Wants It Near FSD’s Price
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMusk says the Cybercab’s $300 monthly fee should drop to about $115, in line with FSD and connectivity. The fee money is small for years: one car per customer, Texas-only geofences.

items.title: Lucid Sinks 8% Despite $1.75 Billion Saudi Lifeline; Tesla Falls 3%, Rivian Dips
items.summary: Saudi Arabia just handed Lucid a longer runway, yet investors are heading for the exits. Behind the selloff sits a debt stack that ranks ahead of common shareholders and one 2027 milestone that could decide everything.
